groups.explanation: Rebecca Bunch (Crazy Ex-Girlfriend) — Rebecca Bunch is also the name of a real person; Eleanor Shellstrop (The Good Place); Ann Perkins (Parks and Recreation) — Ann Perkins is a real journalist; Maeby Fünke (Arrested Development).
